world_seed.visual_direction: verdigris copper, salt-white stone, indigo water, coral-red seals

genre: tidal diplomatic habitat, sediment memory, ecological treaty economy
premise: An embassy built on shifting sands reconstructs the legal personhood of extinct rivers using sediment memories and tidal evidence.
simulation_objective: Negotiate the restoration of watershed rights through the trade of authenticated silt and flood testimony.
economy_focus: The trade of sediment samples, flow rights, and coral-sealed treaty documents.
exploration_focus: Discovering hidden river memories revealed only during low tide cycles.
conflict_tone: High-stakes diplomatic tension and environmental desperation.
visual_style: Top-down pixel art with verdigris copper accents, salt-white stone floors, and deep indigo water shadows.
